dcterms:description: A dataset for subtask A of SemEval-2019 Task 9, containing 8500 examples, with 6415 labeled as non-suggestion and 2085 as suggestion. It includes a trial dataset with 592 examples, evenly split between the two classes.
dcterms:title: SemEval-2019 Task 9 Subtask A Dataset

dcterms:description: A dataset used for subtask B of SemEval-2019 Task 9, containing nearly 200k examples of hotel reviews without labels, utilized for cross-domain classification.
dcterms:title: Hotel Review Dataset
